description: Explicit corrections for wrong ground/stadium values in raw source data. Raw Branntall files are never edited.

corrections.source_reference: Reported by project owner during stadium-count review
corrections.reason: Branntall raw data lists this Viking-Brann match at SR-Bank Arena. The project owner verifies that SR-Bank Arena, now Lyse Arena, opened on 2004-05-01, so Viking's 2001 home match against Brann should be Stavanger stadion.
